methods_quotes.q: Overall and for all subgroups, linear and nonlinear trends in COPD prevalence during 2011–2021 were assessed using permutation tests in Joinpoint trend analysis software
Differences by selected characteristics (compared with a reference category) in COPD prevalence for years 2011 and 2021 were assessed using t -tests.
